notes.title: 1.3h Content Patch 2 Dungeon Poll
notes.notes:
Join us in voting on which small dungeon should be included in Content Patch 2.

You can participate in the poll by heading over to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/BHEeHyFjvK]Community Discord[/url]. Select the #content_polls channel and vote on 1 or more of the dungeons which you're most excited about.

Each dungeon is controlled by a unique faction;
       
A: Ninka Stone Tower - Garden bathhouse tower controlled by the Ninka Assassin Guild, located in Lower Slums Ivor.
       
B: Radiant Vaults - Controlled by Eema's Choir, remnant Angels, and Highelf Mages; located in Exile Steppes.
      
C: Jade Kingdom - Taken from the Orcs by the buzzing Zuzu Tribe, accessed via Honeycomb Mountains.
       
D: Featherfall Spire - Controlled by feral Harpy tribe, located in the Sea of Clouds high atop Gaia.
       
E: Ushi Highlands - Controlled by maddened rival Ushi tribe, located in the Western Canyons of Ushi Ranch.

A challenging adventure awaits; the reward of course being food, rare loot, and HENTAI!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828170/efc528f8fecfe0d779a842ee63a0f24387a25f14.png[/img]
Along with the small dungeon will come various fixes/polish throughout the game, additional Hscenes, Act I art overhauls and more!

We hope to see you there.

Unsheathe your blade! Journey to slay the evil Demon Queen Eraanthe!

notes.title: 1.3g3 Content Patch 1 Coming Soon...
notes.notes:
Join us in voting on which small dungeon should be included in the first Content Patch.

You can participate in the poll by heading over to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/BHEeHyFjvK]Community Discord[/url]. Select the #content_polls channel and vote on 1 or more of the dungeons which you're most excited about.

Each dungeon is controlled by a unique faction; whether it's the Deadwood jungle tribe, futanari Angels, honey-addicted Zuzu, sneaky Ninkas, or the zealots of the Scarlet Tome. Challenging enemies & puzzles await; the reward of course being rare loot and HENTAI!

Along with the small dungeon will come various fixes throughout the game, additional Hentai scenes (specifically during the Ivor Castle sneaking mission & Thieve's Guild), some Act I art overhauls and more!

We hope to see you there.

Unsheathe your blade! Journey to slay the evil Demon Queen Eraanthe!
